capabilities: Ranks results by relevance with adjustable weights for title, aliases, headings, tags, properties, path and text
Shows matches as whole notes, sections or blocks with a reason for each
Handles word forms, typos and text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
Supports query syntax with phrases, exclusions, path/tag/property/link filters and OR groups, plus a click-based query builder and saved profiles
Searches by meaning with an on-device model and exposes a search tool to AI agents
disambiguation: Not a summarizer or note-condensing tool; it searches the vault and explains why each result matched.
extras: Meaning search needs a one-time 111 MB download of the static-similarity-mrl-multilingual-v1 model (Apache-2.0) from Hugging Face, kept as a ~28 MB meaning.bin in the plugin folder; the AI agent tool and its settings rows appear only in the desktop app. No accounts, telemetry or clipboard access, and no network connections unless the model is downloaded.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches literal text, so it misses word forms, typos and wrong-layout typing, and it gives no reason for a match or a way to hand a narrow search to an AI agent.

relations.evidence: Add to AGENTS.md (Codex, Cursor and other agents)

summary: Search plugin with ranked results by note, section or block, typo and word-form tolerance, query syntax, saved profiles and optional on-device meaning search.
